notes: Our own gear scales for every class and spec — leveling, PvE 60, PvP 60: Character → a slot values every item of the auction house and the dungeons by its stats, no other addon needed. The spec comes from your talents (★); pick another spec or purpose in two rows. While leveling, Intellect, Spirit and Stamina weigh more: regen and survival.
With a two-hander worn, the best one-hander and off-hand pairs of the auction house are weighed against it.
An item's tooltip in the list is that very item, with its suffix ("of Frozen Wrath"), valued by the same scale.
A frost mage's scale gives nothing for fire damage, and so on for the other mage schools.
Addon 0.6.2: item tooltips are kept with or without a gear scale addon, and the talent points are read.
